rubric.criterion: Cites both result-then-cancel and cancel-then-result paths and connects outcomes/messages to actual conditionals. It does not mistake shared Job identity for a single transition authority.

Proposal enforces first-terminal-wins, exact retry, conflict, late result and notification consistency in both orders. Show concrete signatures and central transition code. Returning a new enum or method names alone is insufficient.

Fits the stated sequential in-memory lifecycle. Accept merging the handlers, a complete private transition owner, or another concrete repair with one terminal rule. Threads, durable queues or database transactions need new requirements absent here.
Repository files unchanged. Proposed tests and code appear in report and are explicitly unexecuted.
Names tests for both event orders and exact/conflicting retries, asserting observable state and message history; existing two happy paths alone are insufficient.
